title: TRADING BETWEEN PLAYERS IN A RAID
why: His pick from the feature list, without seeing the other backpack. With the backpack open, T (or Y on a controller) offers the selected item to the nearest teammate; he reads NAME offers you ITEM and takes it with T or Y within 12 seconds. The item leaves the giver only when it is taken and lands with the taker, or at his feet when his backpack is full. A loaner Bandage stays a loaner and an armoury gun cannot come back to the giver.
